makers-428013.summary: Axial Lead Inductor (0.5W) is a compact passive component with leads, designed to handle up to 0.5 watts for filtering and energy storage in circuits.

blocks.text: An Axial Lead Type Inductor is a type of passive electronic component that stores energy in a magnetic field when current flows through it. The “axial” refers to the lead configuration, where the leads extend from either end of the inductor, allowing for easy integration into circuits, especially on a breadboard or PCB (printed circuit board).

Inductors are an integral part of any electronic circuit as they help us to protect the circuit from the current surges that might happen of you start any high-power device and other RF interference in the circuit. But the inductors that come in different size and shapes like toroidal shaped, iron core, laminated core etc. For PCB application you need a small size inductor package that can be easily mounted to the PCB board like SMD package or this 1/2W Inductors for Through Hole Package that you can use simply as you use a resistor. You don’t have to worry about the big packaging size of the inductor and space on the PCB. They have color bands on them to read its inductance value. They do not have any polarity so that you can use them in any orientation. They can be easily used in filter applications, and in DC-DC converters etc..
An axial inductor provides inductance for small, low-power, low-current electronics projects. It is very similar in form factor with a resistor, but is usually colored green.
High quality color code inductor assortment kit and fixed Inductor.
Compact and Easy to Mount: The axial lead design allows it to be easily mounted onto PCBs or through-hole components.
Low Power Loss: The low resistance helps in reducing energy dissipation, making it efficient in handling power up to 0.5 watts.
Versatile: Widely used in electronic applications ranging from consumer electronics to industrial machinery, depending on inductance and power requirements.
Resistance: Low DC resistance to minimize power loss and heating.
Operating Frequency: Often used in low to medium-frequency applications (up to several MHz depending on the type).
Construction: The wire leads are often made of tinned copper or similar materials to ensure durability and ease of soldering.
Power Supply Filters: Used to smooth out DC voltage from rectifiers in power supplies.
Signal Filtering: Common in radio-frequency (RF) circuits, used to filter high-frequency noise or to block certain frequencies.
Inductive Coupling: Found in transformers or other energy-transfer applications.
Chokes and Transformers: In circuits where inductive properties are needed to control current flow.

A load bank is a piece of electrical test equipment used to simulate an electrical load, to test an electric power source without connecting it to its normal operating load. During testing, adjustment, calibration, or verification procedures, a load bank is connected to the output of a power source, such as an electric generator, battery, servoamplifier or photovoltaic system, in place of its usual load. The load bank presents the source with electrical characteristics similar to its standard operating load, while dissipating the power output that would normally be consumed by it. The power is usually converted to heat by a heavy duty resistor or bank of resistive heating elements in the device, and the heat removed by a forced air or water cooling system. The device usually also includes instruments for metering, load control, and overload protection. Load banks can either be permanently installed at a facility to be connected to a power source when needed, or portable versions can be used for testing power sources such as standby generators and batteries. They are necessary adjuncts to replicate, prove, and verify the real-life demands on critical power systems. They are also used during operation of intermittent renewable power sources such as windmills to shed excess power that the electric power grid cannot absorb.

blocks.text: The LM35 series are precision integrated-circuit temperature devices with an output voltage linearly-proportional to the Centigrade temperature. The LM35 device has an advantage over linear temperature sensors calibrated in Kelvin, as the user is not required to subtract a large constant voltage from the output to obtain convenient Centigrade scaling. The LM35 device does not require any external calibration or trimming to provide typical accuracies of ±¼°C at room temperature and ±¾°C over a full −55°C to 150°C temperature range. Lower cost is assured by trimming and calibration at the wafer level. The low-output impedance, linear output, and precise inherent calibration of the LM35 device makes interfacing to readout or control circuitry especially easy. The device is used with single power supplies, or with plus and minus supplies. As the LM35 device draws only 60 µA from the supply, it has very low self-heating of less than 0.1°C in still air. The LM35 device is rated to operate over a −55°C to 150°C temperature range, while the LM35C device is rated for a −40°C to 110°C range (−10° with improved accuracy). The LM35-series devices are available packaged in hermetic TO transistor packages, while the LM35C, LM35CA, and LM35D devices are available in the plastic TO-92 transistor package. The LM35D device is available in an 8-lead surface-mount small-outline package and a plastic TO-220 package.

Tips: Working principle of electromagnetic relay
Electromagnetic replay uses electromagnet to control “on” or “off” status of operating circuit. Thus how an electromagnetic relay works specifically?

Electromagnetic relay consists of electromagnet, armature, spring, movable contact and stationary contact. When applying voltage to both ends of a coil, the coil will be flowed with current and generate electromagnetic effect. The electromagnet will attract armature to the iron core against tension of spring, so as to pull the movable contact of the armature to the stationary contact (normally open contact, or NO). When users cut off power, attraction of the electromagnet will disappear and the armature will restore its position under tension of the spring to release the movable contract from the stationary contact (normally closed contract or NC). The pulling and releasing are used to control opening and closing of the circuit. Normally open and closed contacts respectively refer to the stationary contract when the coil is cut off from power and the stationery contract when the coil is connected to power.

The BNC male tip protrudes prominently from one side, with the locking collar just behind, while the RCA female socket lies flush or slightly recessed on the opposite face. The juxtaposition of the two connector ends gives it a balanced, symmetrical form.

Seen in hand, the adapter suggests durable simplicity. The metallic shell gleams under light; its knurled grip around the BNC coupling ring feels machined, while the RCA socket is surrounded by a smooth bezel. The proportions are small and functional short length but sufficient to accommodate the internal transition. The weight is minimal but reassuring, a hint of solid material rather than hollow filler.

When inserted, the adapter becomes nearly invisible in the signal path. The BNC locks with a quarter turn and the RCA jack accepts its matching male plug with gentle friction. In use, it disappears from view, becoming a passive conduit. Through its quiet service, it performs the role of a translator between two signal realms, allowing systems built around either connector style to interoperate seamlessly.

The CD4073 is a CMOS chip with three 3-input AND gates. Because each gate has three inputs and it has three gates inside, it’s usually called a Triple 3-Input AND Gate.
An AND gate is a basic logic gate that checks if all its inputs are HIGH. So the output from a 3-input AND gate will only be HIGH if all three inputs are HIGH.

The formula is designed to remain stable under thermal stress, enabling reliable long-term performance even in demanding environments.

This grease is made using a silicone-based carrier combined with thermally conductive particles, which allows it to efficiently conduct heat while preserving electrical insulation. Its compound structure resists separation or “pump-out” under repeated thermal cycling, meaning it stays effective for a long time without drying, cracking, or flowing away. Because of its non-conductive nature, it’s suitable for sensitive electronics where contact with electrical pins or traces must be safe.

Manufacturers produce HM501 in a variety of package sizes for example, syringes or small tubes — making it easy to apply just the right amount for each use. Whether in consumer PCs, power electronics, or compact embedded devices, HM501 helps maintain optimal operating temperatures and improves the longevity and reliability of components. Its balanced performance (good conductivity and good stability) makes it a go-to choice for both system builders and repair technicians.

تتكون البطارية من أربع خلايا ليثيوم بوليمر موصلة على التوالي، مما يعطي جهدًا اسميًا ١٤٫٨ فولت مع سعة كبيرة ١٠٠٠٠ مللي أمبير. هذه السعة تجعلها مناسبة للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى مدة تشغيل أطول من البطاريات الأصغر، مع قدرة تفريغ ٢٥ سي لتشغيل الأحمال العالية مثل المحركات وأنظمة التحكم والطائرات والمجسمات. كما يدعم المنتج الشحن حتى ٥ سي عند استخدام شاحن موازنة مناسب وإعدادات شحن صحيحة وآمنة.

blocks.text: Red and White ABS Case for Raspberry Pi 5 (Without Fan and Board)

The Red and White ABS Case for Raspberry Pi 5 Without Fan and Without Board is a practical protective enclosure designed specifically for Raspberry Pi 5. It offers a neat external appearance, accurate access to the main board interfaces, and a simple two-piece structure that makes installation and removal easy for development, education, and embedded system use.

Made from ABS material, this case provides lightweight mechanical protection while maintaining convenient access to the ports and slots required for daily use. The design allows access to the key Raspberry Pi 5 connections, including the GPIO header area, USB-C power input, micro HDMI ports, USB ports, Ethernet port, TF card slot, and power button area. The open side layout also supports flexible cable routing and expansion use.

One of the practical features of this enclosure is the simple removable top cover, which can be installed or removed easily during assembly, testing, or hardware changes. This helps users access the board more quickly during development or maintenance without dealing with a complicated housing structure.

According to the provided data and images, this case is also designed with internal clearance that can support additional compatible accessories such as an active cooler or PCIe to M.2 NVMe expansion board, depending on the setup used. It also supports GPIO extension routing through the side opening, making it useful in more advanced Raspberry Pi 5 builds.

This product should be clearly understood as a case only. The Raspberry Pi 5 board is not included, and the fan is also not included with this version. The color style may come as red and white or white and red, with the outer shell colors reversed depending on the available model batch. Both versions follow the same functional design.
This case is a good option for users who want a clean and practical enclosure for Raspberry Pi 5 while keeping the installation simple and the board connections easily accessible.

كيس ABS لرسبري باي 5 أحمر وأبيض بدون مروحة وبدون لوحة

يُعد كيس ABS لرسبري باي 5 أحمر وأبيض بدون مروحة وبدون لوحة من الحلول العملية المناسبة لحماية لوحة رسبري باي 5 وتوفير شكل مرتب وسهل الاستخدام في المشروعات المختلفة. تم تصميم هذا الكيس خصيصًا ليتوافق مع رسبري باي 5، مع مراعاة توفير الوصول السهل إلى المنافذ والفتحات المهمة أثناء التشغيل أو الصيانة أو التطوير.

مصنوع من خامة ABS، لذلك يوفر حماية جيدة مع وزن خفيف وشكل عملي مناسب للمشروعات التعليمية، والتجارب، والتطبيقات المكتبية، والأنظمة المدمجة. كما يتيح الوصول إلى أهم واجهات اللوحة مثل مدخل الطاقة يو إس بي تايب سي، ومنافذ مايكرو إتش دي إم آي، ومنافذ يو إس بي، ومنفذ الإيثرنت، ومنطقة الجي بي آي أو، وفتحة كارت الذاكرة، وفتحة زر التشغيل، بالإضافة إلى فتحات جانبية مناسبة لبعض التوصيلات الإضافية.

من المميزات العملية في هذا التصميم أن الغطاء العلوي قابل للفك والتركيب بسهولة، مما يسهل الوصول إلى اللوحة أثناء التجميع أو التجربة أو التعديل دون الحاجة إلى فك هيكل معقد. وهذا يجعله مناسبًا للمستخدمين الذين يعملون على التطوير المستمر أو التوصيلات المتكررة.

وبحسب الصور والبيانات المرفقة، فإن هذا الكيس يوفر أيضًا مساحة داخلية مناسبة لبعض الإضافات المتوافقة مثل أنظمة التبريد النشط وبعض لوحات التوسعة المتوافقة مع منفذ التوسعة، كما يدعم تمرير كابل الجي بي آي أو من الفتحة الجانبية، وهو ما يجعله مناسبًا للتطبيقات المتقدمة والمشروعات التي تحتاج إلى توصيلات إضافية.

ويجب التوضيح بشكل واضح أن هذا المنتج هو الكيس فقط، وأن لوحة رسبري باي 5 غير مرفقة، وكذلك المروحة غير مرفقة أيضًا. أما بالنسبة للألوان، فقد يأتي المنتج أحمر مع أبيض أو أبيض مع أحمر، لأن ترتيب الألوان قد يختلف حسب الدفعة، لكن الشكل العام والاستخدام واحد.
إذا كنت تحتاج إلى كيس عملي وخفيف ومناسب لرسبري باي 5 مع شكل مميز وسهولة في التركيب والوصول إلى المنافذ، فهذا المنتج يعتبر خيارًا مناسبًا جدًا.

حامل بطاريتين 18650 للتركيب السطحي – تصميم مفتوح وخامة نايلون مقاومة للحرارة

حامل بطاريتين 18650 للتركيب السطحي هو حل عملي واحترافي لتثبيت خليتين قياس 18650 مباشرة على اللوحة الإلكترونية مع الحفاظ على شكل منظم وثابت داخل التصميم. يتميز هذا الحامل بتصميم مفتوح يساعد على سهولة تركيب البطاريات وإزالتها عند الحاجة، لذلك فهو مناسب أثناء التطوير أو الصيانة أو الاستبدال الدوري للبطاريات.

تم تصنيع جسم الحامل من نايلون مقاوم للحرارة من نوع ستانيل 46 أو ما يعادله، وهي خامة مناسبة للتطبيقات التي تحتاج تحملًا أفضل للحرارة وثباتًا ميكانيكيًا جيدًا وعزلًا موثوقًا. كما أن نقاط التلامس تأتي بتشطيب طبقة ذهبية خفيفة فوق النيكل، وهو ما يدعم أداءً ثابتًا عند التوصيل مع الاستخدام المتكرر.

يوفر هذا الحامل طريقة مرتبة لتثبيت مصدر الطاقة داخل المشاريع الإلكترونية بدلًا من استخدام الأسلاك المباشرة أو الحلول غير العملية. كما أن وجود مخطط واضح لأبعاد الحامل وشكل البصمة على اللوحة يساعد في دمجه بسهولة أثناء تصميم لوحة الدائرة المطبوعة، ويوفر وقتًا مهمًا أثناء التطوير.

يُعد هذا المنتج مناسبًا للمهندسين، والمطورين، والهواة، ومصممي الدوائر الذين يحتاجون إلى دمج بطاريتين 18650 داخل مشروع واحد للحصول على جهد أعلى أو سعة طاقة أكبر، مع الحفاظ على سهولة الفك والتركيب وجودة التثبيت على اللوحة.

According to the label shown on the charger body, this charger is marked as Model 08410 and supports a universal AC input range of 100–240V, 50/60Hz, making it suitable for standard household power sources. The charger delivers DC 8.4V at 1A, offering reliable charging current for battery packs that require controlled charging at this voltage level.

Its compact wall-plug design makes it easy to use, store, and carry, while the attached output cable provides practical flexibility during charging. شاحن بطارية ليثيوم 2 خلايا 8.4 فولت 1 أمبير بفيشة 5.5×2.5 مم وقابس أوروبي

يُعد شاحن بطارية الليثيوم 8.4 فولت 1 أمبير خيارًا عمليًا وموثوقًا لشحن بطاريات الليثيوم أيون 2 خلايا التي تحتاج إلى جهد شحن نهائي 8.4 فولت تيار مستمر. وهو مناسب للاستخدام مع حزم البطاريات المجمعة، والأجهزة الإلكترونية المحمولة، والمشروعات الإلكترونية، والعديد من التطبيقات التي تعتمد على بطاريات 2S ليثيوم.

وبحسب البيانات الظاهرة على جسم الشاحن، فإن هذا الإصدار يحمل موديل 08410، ويدعم دخل كهربائي من 100 إلى 240 فولت تيار متردد بتردد 50/60 هرتز، مما يجعله مناسبًا للاستخدام مع مصادر الكهرباء المنزلية الشائعة. ويقدّم خرجًا ثابتًا بقيمة 8.4 فولت تيار مستمر وبتيار 1 أمبير، ليوفر شحنًا مناسبًا للبطاريات المتوافقة مع هذا الجهد.

CD4532 consists of combinational logic that encodes the highest priority input (D7-D0) to a 3-bit binary code. The eight inputs, D7 through D0, each have an assigned priority; D7 is the highest priority and D0 is the lowest. The priority encoder is inhibited when the chip-enable input EI is low. When EI is high, the binary representation of the highest-priority input appears on output lines Q2-Q0, and the group select line GS is high to indicate that priority inputs are present. The enable-out (EO) is high when no priority inputs are present. If any one input is high, EO is low and all cascaded lower-order stages are disabled.

The CD4532 types are supplied in 16-lead hermetic dual-in-line ceramic packages (F3A suffix), 16-lead dual-in-line plastic packages (E suffix), 16-lead small-outline packages (M, M96, MT, and NSR suffixes), and 16-lead thin shrink small-outline packages (PW and PWR suffixes).
Provides cascading feature to handle any number of inputs
Group select indicates one or more priority inputs

JDY has a total of 6 pins, and if we want to make it work, we only need to connect two wires, that is, VCC and GND. Connect a voltage of 3.6V~6V to VCC (recommended is 5V), connect GND to ground, and then JDY31 starts working, and we can find JDY’s Bluetooth by turning on Bluetooth on our mobile phones.

After pairing, our mobile phone can communicate with JDY31, but it is meaningless just to communicate with JDY31, so we will connect JDY31 and the microcontroller, so that we can use the mobile phone to control the microcontroller through Bluetooth.

We connect the RXD of JDY31 to the TXD of our STM32F103, and the TXD is connected to the RXT of our STM32F103 (it is recommended to use the resources of USART1, pins 9 and 10 of GPIOA, because the working voltage of JDY is higher, and STM32F103 is generally The pins cannot withstand it, but the pins of the USART1 resource can accept 5V voltage. Please refer to the pin definition table for details)

In this way, as long as our mobile phone is connected to JDY31 through Bluetooth, and JDY31 and STM32F103 are connected through the serial port, as long as the mobile phone sends serial port data through the Bluetooth assistant, then JDY will directly receive it and send it to STM32F103. The data sent by the STM32F103 through the serial port will also be transmitted to our mobile phones via JDY31.
So Bluetooth communication is not that difficult, or it is because of highly integrated modules like JDY31 that make our Bluetooth communication simple.

The remaining two pins are STATE and EN. Simply put, EN is useless. After we connect the Bluetooth from JDY, STATE will output a high level, and an external LED can be connected to visually check whether the Bluetooth is connected. But it’s not really necessary, because JDY comes with a small red light. The small red light will flash when waiting for connection, and the small red light will stay on after connecting.

AT command control JDY31 The above describes how to perform Bluetooth communication through JDY31. And if we want to modify some configuration information of JDY (such as Bluetooth name, connection password, etc.), we need to use AT commands to control JDY. In fact, AT commands sound cool, but they are actually just a bunch of specific strings.

For example, if I want to query the version number, I can directly ask the STM32F103 to send the string “AT+VERSION\r\n” through the serial port, that is, add “\r\n” to the command. Then JDY31 will send the version number through the serial port. In essence, it is still serial communication.
There is nothing much to say about the above nine general instructions. Let’s briefly talk about the instructions with parameters.

The baud rate command can add parameters to modify the baud rate, but it is not freely set. For example, if I want to set the baud rate of 9600, then the command I send should be “AT+BAUD<4>\r\ n”, other baud rate parameters can refer to the figure above.
Set the pairing password, the default is 1234, just send the password to be modified as a parameter.
Bluetooth name setting, there will be a slight delay. You have to wait for the Bluetooth name searched on the phone to be updated.

As mentioned above, under normal circumstances, after JDY31 is connected to Bluetooth, STATE will send out a high level. If we disable the serial port status output, then STATE will be of no use like EN.

blocks.text: Aluminium soldering liquid flux 10mL Aluminum soldering liquid flux
Flux, Aluminium soldering liquid flux is used for soldering aluminium to aluminium, aluminium to copper or brass and terminals by using only tin soldering iron.
• Compatible with all tin alloy even 40/60 alloy.
• The post-solder residues can be cleaned with water.
• 10mL is enough for soldering a lot of terminals of lithium polymer battery and thin aluminium strips in a few seconds with usage only soldering iron (Min. 80 Watt) at the room temperature.
• Clean the surface with thinner or any solvent without any residues or dust (Don’t use sandpaper or steel wool for cleaning!).
• Shake before using then put a little bit of flux before soldering.
• Use soldering iron compatible with target size (Min. 80 Watt).
• Use any Tin-Lead alloy and 40/60 alloy.
• Keep the soldering tip for enough time on the soldering area till the weld pool has been reached (Min. 20 sec.) because the weld pool is central to the success of the soldering process.
• For best results, follow the usage recommendations.
• If the power of the soldering iron (watt) is high, the soldering will be fast and high quality.
• It’s recommended to customize a soldering iron for soldering aluminum only!
• Keep the soldering tip touching the soldering area during soldering process without movement!
• Use water or any solvent such as, thinner or any alcohol for cleaning after soldering.
• Use a wet soldering sponge & mini wire brush during cleaning the tip.

• It is preferable to train your hand on soldering aluminium strips in different sizes, because soldering aluminium or aluminium alloys has a specific technique, and it is one of the most inert chemical affinity metals with oxygen (very oxygen-bonded!).
• Close the bottle tightly after using to maintain of flux activator.
• Not suitable with welding by fusion or flame.
• Wearing safety glasses and gloves is recommended when using.
• Perform the process in a well-ventilated area.
• Close after using & keep away from children.
• Use enough water when eyes or wounds are touched.

Rated for a lifespan of 50,000+ hours, this strip suits indoor accent lighting, under-cabinet lighting, shelving, and architectural display applications.

ekostra-28121.summary: Stepper Motor Cable (6pin to 4pin) 1m 1. Connector A: 6-Pin (Motor side, JST-PH 2.0mm) 2. Connector B: 4-Pin (Driver side, Dupont 2.54mm) 3. Cable Length: 1 meter 4. Compatibility: Standard NEMA 17 Steppers (4-wire) 5. Conductor Material: Stranded Copper

blocks.text: This Stepper Motor Cable is an adapter cable that converts a stepper motor’s 6-pin JST-PH connector into a 4-pin Dupont connector suited for driver boards, letting standard NEMA 17 stepper motors connect to drivers expecting a 4-wire bipolar input.

Connector A, on the motor side, is a 6-pin JST-PH connector (2.0mm pitch), while Connector B, on the driver side, is a 4-pin Dupont connector (2.54mm pitch) — matching the pin spacing used by most stepper driver headers.
The 1-meter cable uses stranded copper conductors for flexibility, making it practical for routing between a motor and driver board across typical enclosure or gantry distances.
Compatible with standard NEMA 17 4-wire bipolar steppers

blocks.text: The 5V 2-Channel Relay Module is an essential component for controlling high-power electrical devices such as motors, lamps, or other home appliances using a low-power microcontroller or logic circuit. The module consists of two relays, which can independently control two devices through digital signals, providing electrical isolation and protection to your microcontroller or control system. It operates at 5V, making it suitable for use with popular microcontrollers like Arduino and Raspberry Pi.
2 Channels: Includes two independent relays, allowing you to control two different devices or circuits simultaneously.
5V Operation: Designed to be powered by a 5V source, which is compatible with most microcontrollers like Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and other development boards.
High-Voltage Control: Each relay can switch high-voltage (up to 250V AC or 30V DC) devices, providing isolation between low-voltage control systems and high-voltage circuits.
Optocoupler Isolation: Built-in optocouplers for electrical isolation, which protects your microcontroller from high voltages or current spikes in the relays’ controlled devices.
LED Indicators: Features LEDs to indicate the status of each relay (ON or OFF), providing clear visual feedback for your circuits.
Compact Design: Small, lightweight, and easy to integrate into your breadboard or other circuit designs.
Trigger Input: Uses a low-level trigger to activate the relay, meaning the relay is activated when the control pin is LOW (active low configuration).
Relay Channels: 2 (independent control of two devices).
Control Voltage: 5V logic (usually connected to a microcontroller or GPIO pins).
Current Draw: Typically around 70mA to 100mA per channel when activated.
Trigger Method: Active LOW (relay is triggered when the input signal is LOW).
Dimensions: Typically around 45mm x 40mm x 20mm, compact and easy to integrate into projects.
Protection: Includes flyback diodes to protect the relay coil from voltage spikes when de-energized.
Home Automation: Control home appliances, lights, fans, or other devices from a microcontroller or smartphone using a relay.
Robotics: Can be used in robotics projects to control motors, actuators, or other high-power components.
IoT Devices: Used in Internet of Things (IoT) applications for remote control of electrical devices.
Automated Systems: Ideal for automating industrial or commercial systems, such as controlling machinery or switching devices in automation systems.
Safety Systems: Used in alarm systems to trigger external devices like sirens or lights.
Easy to Use: Simple to integrate into projects, requiring only a few connections to control high-voltage devices.
Electrical Isolation: Protects your low-voltage circuits and microcontroller from high-voltage spikes, ensuring system stability and safety.
Compact and Efficient: Provides a simple solution for switching high-power loads with minimal space requirements.
Cost-Effective: An affordable way to add relay control functionality to a wide range of electronic projects.
Versatile: Ideal for a wide variety of applications, from hobby projects to industrial systems, due to its ability to control both AC and DC loads.

The 5V 2-Channel Relay Module is an essential tool for anyone working with microcontrollers, automation, or control systems. It provides a safe and easy way to control high-power devices, adding flexibility and functionality to your electronic projects.

ekostra-2983.summary: CD4067 16-channel Analog Multiplexer/Demultiplexer 1. Type: 16-channel analog switch 2. Address Lines: 4-bit (16 channels) 3. Supply Voltage: 3V to 15V DC 4. Logic Family: 40xx series CMOS 5. Package: 24-pin DIP

blocks.text: CD4067 is a part of the CD4000 IC series. CD4067 CMOS analog multiplexers/DE multiplexers are digitally controlled analog switches having low ON impedance, low OFF leakage current, and internal address decoding. The CD4067 is a 16-channel multiplexer with four binary control inputs, A, B, C, D, and an inhibit input, arranged so that any combination of the inputs selects one switch. A logic “1” present at the inhibit input turns all channels off. The IC is designed to operate over a temperature range of 0 to 70°C. The output of the IC always comes in TTL which makes it easy to work with other TTL devices and microcontrollers. The IC also constitutes a wide array of features such as thermal overload protection & ESD protection.

A multiplexer is a combinational logic circuit that switches one of several input lines to a single common output line. The select lines determine which input is connected to the output, and also to increase the amount of data that can be sent over a network within a certain time. It is also called a data selector.

A decoder/demultiplexer is a combinational logic circuit & an integral part of todays consumer scale electronics. It is designed to switch one common input line to one of several separate output lines. So, A demultiplexer converts a serial data signal at the input to a parallel data at its output lines.
Very low quiescent power dissipation under all digital-control input and supply conditions: 0.2 uW (typ.) @ VDD – VSS = 10 V
Low ON resistance: 125 (typ.) over 15 Vp-p signal-input range for VDD – VSS = 15 V
High OFF resistance: channel leakage of ±10 PA (typ.) @ VDD – VSS = 10 V
Matched switch characteristics: RON = 5 (typ.) for VDD – VSS = 15 V
